situation (example wording): "Murder clearance rate in Memphis in 2024" (a Part I offense, a completed year)
what the app does today: NIBRS clearances are refused in the slice.
proposed behavior: A Part I offense's clearance rate for a completed year comes from the Crime Index historical clearances data (the FBI annual method), not computed from NIBRS (routing, as P53). The current year's clearance rate (an agency, a state or the nation) is computed from NIBRS (P129): the offenses cleared over the offenses reported in the months the data holds, rate only, the months said; a state or the nation counts only the Consistent Reporting Agencies and says so. Not decided: clearance for NIBRS-only offenses; no method is assumed for those.
exact default or choices offered: Source: the Crime Index historical clearances.
status: Decided 2026-10-29 (Jeff: "the clearance rate of a part I offense for a historical year is in the crime index historical database and should be calculated on that")
test cases: Tests that cite this row: scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts.
